description: Variation of condition C1 (approved drawings) pursuant to planning permission PA25/3506 to allow for revised, timber frame repair methodology, wall build-ups and breathable insulation strategy, and roof, eaves, rainwater goods, roof and construction details; amendments to windows; updated window and door schedules; and associated conservation-led amendments to ensure compatibility with the listed building fabric.
decision_conditions:
Your property falls within a Flood Zone and/or in an area where there is evidence of a risk from other sources of flooding, including surface water, ground water and sewer flooding therefore a Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) is required for your application.

Please mark the relevant box from the link below and submit.
